kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app: docs/store-policy/NexusTransferPay.json:95 Apple 1.3 'Kids Category' applies=false ('none of [kids] detected in the current source', generated 2026-10-14); store/apps/NexusTransferPay.json:12 primary_category FINANCE. No Kids/Families store metadata found (grep of store/ and docs/). Age-rating questionnaire answers for this app were not read (store/apps/NexusTransferPay.json lists it as having no schema field).

interstitial.why: No AglAds.onTransition() in flutter-mobile-app/lib (grep: none); the tab-change interstitial was removed (spec NexusTransferPay.md:234). Keep it absent: money-transfer cost audit in a finance context; the code comment requires the ad never sit beside a form or money input (corridor_screen.dart:138-141). Spec Q4 (:410) is the founder's call if one is ever wanted.

native.why: Finance/payments context. The only lists are the user's own recorded transfers (SendRow in corridor and ledger) - sensitive money data, where the founder rule forbids native. There is no browse/discovery feed of external content.

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (grep premium/quota/in_app/purchase in flutter-mobile-app/lib: no hits; no in_app_purchase in pubspec.yaml)
rewarded.why: Nothing non-essential to reward, and any rewarded unlock in an app Apple already flagged for IAP products (2.1(b), spec NexusTransferPay.md:18,409) would invite a 3.1.1 question. No.
